# date

Parse and format dates through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'

moonx cli/date -u -d '@0' '+%Y-%m-%d'
```

Format the current time or a supplied date. Supports UTC, fractional epoch values and the documented TZ/TZif/POSIX timezone profile.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-u`, `--utc` | Use UTC. |
| `-d VALUE`, `--date VALUE` | Read an ISO date/time or @SECONDS. |
| `--iso VALUE` | ISO output: date, hours, minutes, seconds or ns. Default: `date`. |
| `-R`, `--rfc-email` | Print an RFC email timestamp. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Ambiguous or nonexistent local times are rejected. Full GNU relative-date grammar and setting the system clock are unsupported.
- Timezone file access and local-zone discovery depend on the host and launcher permissions.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
